app.name: Qu33ph
app.short_description: The marker throwing game + the arcade
app.long_description:
Qu33ph for the Wii. Swing the Wiimote to throw: hold it upright, aim with the D-pad, and flick it at the TV. The harder the swing, the harder the throw.
1 PLAYER, 2 PLAYER, OLYMPICS, the slot, PlinQu33ph and the arcade: Mini Qu33ph, Qu33ph-Ball, Fidget, Bowling, Stack, Flip, Dozer, Jump and Pinball.
Buttons: A select/throw, B back, + pause, - quit, 1/2 turn the marker, HOME back to the Homebrew Channel. Nunchuk, Classic Controller and GameCube pads work too. Progress saves to the SD card.
